entries.headline: Ads keywords tightened for winter; GHL source tracking corrected
entries.text:
*Quality HVAC: work report, Nov 12–18*

Ads keywords tightened for winter; GHL source tracking corrected

*Done this week*
• *Ads:* Refined the winter campaign keywords: cut the list from 34 to 11, added 6 high-intent searches (furnace repair, no heat, emergency repair, furnace tune-up), and paused keywords that spent budget without producing leads.
• *Ads:* Added negative keywords to block competitor names, troubleshooting searches, and equipment-shopping queries so budget focuses on people ready to book.
• *CRM & automations:* Fixed contact source attribution in the CRM: tags and lead sources are now assigned automatically based on where each contact comes from, replacing the manual process.

*In progress*
• *Ads:* Auditing the web lead tracking flow to ensure campaign and channel data is correctly captured and passed through on all paid traffic pages, so every form submission is properly attributed.
• *Google listings:* Burr Ridge Google listing verification is still pending — waiting on the new signage to be installed before the live video verification step can be completed.
• *Website & SEO:* Google Business Profile posting has been restarted for both Quality HVAC and Fibid after a gap since 9/29; first posts are being prepared this week with a weekly seasonal heating cadence planned going forward.

*Waiting on you*
• *Google listings:* Burr Ridge verification: once the new "Fibid Heating & Air Conditioning" signage (door, lobby directory, and inside decal) is installed, please let us know so we can walk you through the Google live video verification from your own login.

*Coming up next*
• *Ads:* Complete the web lead tracking audit and confirm UTM/source parameters are visible on every lead record.
• *Website & SEO:* Publish the first Google Business Profile post for Quality HVAC and Fibid and confirm the planned weekly posting day for each.

entries.headline: New site launched, booking tracking live, and three new video ads in production
entries.text:
*Senior Insurance: work report, Nov 12–18*

New site launched, booking tracking live, and three new video ads in production

*Done this week*
• *Website & SEO:* Launched the redesigned website with all tracking carried over from the old site: call tracking, ad integrations, and form-to-CRM connections.
• *Website & SEO:* Both thank-you pages are live. All 5 forms and the appointment calendar now redirect to the correct thank-you page (English or Arabic) after submission, and lead tracking events fire on each.
• *Google listings:* Completed initial Google Business Profile SEO review and delivered a full report.
• *CRM & automations:* Fixed and published the Crown Point booking attribution workflow. Both Meta and Google booking paths tested and confirmed: click IDs, UTMs, keywords, and the correct ad channel tag all save properly without creating duplicate contacts.
• *Ads:* Google Ads restructured since Nov 10: trimmed to 5 high-intent keywords per campaign at top-of-page bids, plus added lower-competition terms. Result: impressions up from ~2/day to ~35/day, 42 clicks at 17% CTR, 92% top-of-page rate.

*In progress*
• *Video & content:* Three Ken Peterson video ads are being edited ("Your Plan May Be Going Away", "The Supplement Window", "Extras vs. Your Meds") — cut lists are assigned and source footage is ready for the editor.
• *Ads:* New Meta video ads for the Ken Peterson campaign are ready to launch pending receipt of the final video files.
• *CRM & automations:* Investigating why some leads arriving from Meta and other sources create pipeline opportunities without a source attached — identifying each broken path and fixing them so every new opportunity records where it came from.
• *CRM & automations:* Looking into the best way to link related contacts in the CRM (e.g. a caller who is the adult child or spouse of the person needing coverage) — confirming what's already built and defining the method for the team to follow.
• *CRM & automations:* Intermittent dropped calls on the Meta line (708-847-5143) are being monitored — tracing each missed call in the CRM by caller number and time to identify the pattern and propose a fix.

*Waiting on you*
• *Google listings:* Please send over the office photos you mentioned so we can add them to your Google listings.
• *CRM & automations:* Could you confirm whether call forwarding is active on the dedicated Ken Peterson campaign phone number? We need that confirmed before those ads go live.
• *CRM & automations:* For the dropped-call issue on the Meta line: when a call drops or doesn't ring, please send us the caller's number and the Chicago time it happened so we can trace it.
• *Ads:* Please review the Google Ads budget recommendation (pause Part D, double daily budgets for Medicare Advantage and Supplement to ~$64/day) so we can move before open enrollment ends Dec 7.

*Coming up next*
• *Google listings:* Apply Google Business Profile updates: holiday hours (closed Thanksgiving & Black Friday, open Nov 30–Dec 7 including weekends), English + Arabic languages, and fix the all-lowercase location name.
• *Video & content:* Deliver the three Ken Peterson edited ads for approval, then launch the Meta campaign once the dedicated tracking number is confirmed.
• *CRM & automations:* Complete setup and testing of the Ken Peterson dedicated phone number — confirm forwarding order, CRM logging, and source tagging before the ads go live.
• *CRM & automations:* Fix all opportunity-source gaps so no new lead enters the pipeline without a recorded source.
